packages/shared/src/logger.ts.summary: Structured JSON logger every service writes through. Nothing internal below it, which is exactly why almost the whole system rests on it.

packages/shared/src/errors.ts.summary: AppError and NotFound, the error types every service throws. Each error is also logged, so this file couples error handling to logging.

packages/shared/src/http.ts.summary: Tiny fetch wrapper used for every service-to-service call. Turns upstream failures into 502 AppErrors.

packages/shared/src/config.ts.summary: Reads required env vars and fails fast at boot. The database URL of three services goes through here.

packages/shared/src/index.ts.summary: Barrel file for @ride/shared. 21 files import it, so any breaking change here ripples into every service.

services/users/src/index.ts.summary: Front door of the users service. The gateway and rides both call it over HTTP to verify tokens and load riders.

services/users/src/tokens.ts.summary: Verifies auth tokens, checking the Redis-backed cache first. Every authenticated request in the system ends up here.

services/users/src/cache.ts.summary: In-memory stand-in for the Redis token cache. Small file, big blast radius: auth depends on it.

services/rides/src/domain/matching.ts.summary: Core ride flow: finds the nearest driver, prices the trip, saves it and publishes ride.requested. Shares a circular dependency with eta.ts.

services/rides/src/domain/eta.ts.summary: ETA maths. Imports nearestDriver back from matching.ts, which closes the only crack in the building.

services/rides/src/clients/pricing.ts.summary: HTTP client for the Python pricing service. If pricing is down, no ride can be requested.

services/rides/src/repo.ts.summary: Ride persistence on Postgres via DATABASE_URL.

services/payments/src/ledger.ts.summary: Charges riders through Stripe and writes the ledger row. The only place money moves.

services/gateway/src/middleware/auth.ts.summary: Wraps every public route and verifies the caller with the users service before letting the request through.
